rules.name: Energy Isolation
rules.description: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins. Ensure all energy sources (electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, chemical, thermal) are properly isolated, locked, tagged, and tested before performing maintenance or repair.
mandatory_barriers: Lockout / Tagout (LOTO) application
Test for zero energy before starting
Permit to Work with isolation certificate
Dual valve isolation on hydrocarbon lines
rules.recommended_action: Immediately stop work, apply certified LOTO locks, test for zero energy in presence of Authorized Electrical Person (AEP), and verify isolation log.

rules.name: Confined Space
rules.description: Obtain authorization before entering a confined space. Verify atmospheric testing (oxygen, flammables, H2S, toxic gases), ensure continuous ventilation, and maintain a dedicated standby person and rescue equipment.
mandatory_barriers: Multi-gas test completed and signed within valid window
Confined Space Entry Permit authorized
Dedicated trained Standby Person stationed at entry
Forced positive mechanical ventilation active
rules.recommended_action: Evacuate personnel immediately, prohibit entry, perform calibrated 4-gas test, verify forced ventilation, and post certified standby watchman.

rules.name: Working at Height
rules.description: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height. Wear certified fall arrest equipment with 100% tie-off when working above 1.8 meters or near unprotected edges, and ensure scaffolding is inspected and tagged green.
mandatory_barriers: Full body safety harness connected to certified anchor
Scaffolding green tag inspection valid
Edge protection and toe boards installed
100% tie-off compliance maintained
rules.recommended_action: Halt elevated work, enforce full harness tie-off to load-rated anchorage, inspect scaffolding tag status, and provide safe work platform.

rules.name: Hot Work
rules.description: Control flammables and ignition sources. Obtain hot work authorization, conduct gas testing for flammables, clear combustible materials within 15 meters, and station a fire watch with ready extinguishing equipment.
mandatory_barriers: Hot Work Permit Class-A authorized
LEL continuous combustible gas monitoring reading 0%
Fire watchman with charged pressurized extinguisher present
15-meter clearance or fire retardant habitat enclosure
rules.recommended_action: Extinguish open flame/sparks, re-verify gas-free certificate with calibrated LEL meter, check habitat integrity, and verify fire watch posting.

rules.name: Line of Fire
rules.description: Keep yourself and others out of the line of fire. Position yourself to avoid moving machinery, pressurized discharge, suspended loads, high-tension lines, whip hazards, and projectile paths.
mandatory_barriers: Barricading and red warning tape around danger zones
Pressure whip checks and safety cables installed
Guards installed over rotating shafts and pinch points
Clear personnel exclusion zone maintained
rules.recommended_action: Relocate personnel outside swing/rupture radius, install safety whip-checks on all pressurized lines, and restore machinery safety guards.

rules.name: Safe Mechanical Lifting
rules.description: Plan lifting operations and control the area. Never walk or stand under a suspended load, verify certified rigging gear, do not exceed crane safe working load (SWL), and use tagline control.
mandatory_barriers: Lifting plan approved and tool box talk conducted
Third-party inspection certificates valid for crane & tackle
Taglines used to guide load without touching
No entry permitted under suspended load footprint
rules.recommended_action: Lower load safely, inspect sling third-party color codes, enforce strict exclusion barricade beneath boom path, and verify rigger competency.

rules.name: Bypassing Safety Controls
rules.description: Obtain authorization before overriding or disabling safety controls. Never bypass ESD valves, pressure safety valves (PSVs), high-level alarms, or fire and gas detectors without formal Management of Change (MOC) approval.
mandatory_barriers: Formal MOC and Override Log authorized by Installation Manager
Compensating mitigation measures operational
Time-limited override with shift handover sign-off
Continuous physical monitoring during bypass
rules.recommended_action: Reinstate safety interlock/ESD immediately. If bypass is critical, complete formal risk assessment and MOC approval with senior HSE sign-off.

rules.name: Driving
rules.description: Follow safe driving rules. Wear seatbelts, adhere to speed limits, do not use mobile phones while operating vehicles, perform pre-trip inspections, and respect driver journey management rest rules.
mandatory_barriers: Seatbelts fastened for all occupants
GPS in-vehicle monitoring system (IVMS) active and within speed limits
Zero mobile phone usage while driving
Pre-trip vehicle safety checklist completed
rules.recommended_action: Enforce defensive driving policy, review IVMS speed event telemetry, inspect vehicle fitness, and suspend non-compliant transport operations.

rules.name: Work Authorization
rules.description: Work with a valid permit when required. Understand the scope of work, verify that hazards are assessed (JSA/TRA), ensure required controls are in place, and re-authorize permit if conditions change.
mandatory_barriers: Signed Permit to Work posted at work site
Job Safety Analysis (JSA) reviewed by all work party members
Permit Issuer field verification conducted
Daily toolbox talk recorded with sign-in sheet
rules.recommended_action: Suspend task until valid PTW is countersigned, conduct comprehensive on-site JSA review with crew, and verify all control barriers in place.

rules.name: Dropped Objects
rules.description: Prevent dropped objects. Secure all tools and portable equipment when working elevated, install secondary retention on overhead fixtures, and maintain red drop zones beneath active work.
mandatory_barriers: Tools tethered with wrist/structure lanyards
Secondary retention wire rope secured on elevated lights/fixtures
Barricaded drop zone below with danger signage
Inspection of derrick structure for loose items
rules.recommended_action: Barricade ground exclusion zone immediately, retrofit approved tool tethers and secondary retention clamps, and conduct DROPS sweep before work resumes.
